definition_review.complete_reduction_criterion: All positive one-step common-factor reductions are indexed by integer c>1 with c|gcd(A,B). A sequence of such divisions is valid; the irreducible endpoint has coprime numerator/denominator. A fraction already coprime, such as8/9, has no positive common divisor>1 and remains unchanged.
constraints: Do not reject a valid partial common-factor reduction solely for not yet being irreducible unless the visible task explicitly requests lowest terms.
Cancellation in a sum requires a common factor of the entire numerator; terms cannot be individually canceled across plus/minus signs.
70a/(140a) keeps the original domain a!=0; the simplified constant does not define the original expression at a=0.
No N-zero convention is invoked by these source problems.
